caption: The drawing depicts four views of a smoking pipe, with the central object rendered in full color and detail. The main pipe in the center is brown with intricate carvings featuring figures, animals, and foliage, and it is capped with a metallic, domed lid equipped with a curved handle and a small round knob. The stem and mouthpiece are also bordered in a darker metallic color. Surrounding the colored pipe on the top left, top right, and bottom right are three additional outlines of the same object, rendered in fine, light gray line work. These outlines display various detailed views and carvings of the pipe from different perspectives, including frontal, profile, and top-down views, revealing elements such as animal figures and decorative motifs. The drawing is framed by a thin rectangular border, and the name "Carl Keksi" is printed in simple type in the lower right corner outside the border. The overall composition is arranged symmetrically on a cream-colored background.
title: Pipe Bowl
